issues.description:
Create new dockerized .NET MCP Server

Official MCP site and documentation [https://modelcontextprotocol.io/docs/getting-started/intro|https://modelcontextprotocol.io/docs/getting-started/intro|smart-link] 

*Location Based Search* *-+ Tee Times  Tool-*

ChatGPT recommended to only have one tool to support all similar searches even if they contain different combinations of filters. It also recommended that one tool be used for facility search + tee time search. [https://chatgpt.com/share/e/69861bbf-3de0-800f-8efc-0cd8a1759a85|https://chatgpt.com/share/e/69861bbf-3de0-800f-8efc-0cd8a1759a85|smart-link] . {color:#ff991f}Based on new design requirements, the initial launch of this will not include sample tee times and rate selections but we should still keep the code present because it will be exposed in subsequent phases. {color}

Use {{ChannelId 331}} for all API calls

Prod API Creds: TBD

DEV API Creds: TBD

* Call this API to get the facility results and info: [https://api.gnsvc.com/GolfNowAPI.svc/rest/channel/331/facility-summaries?q=geolocation&skip=0&sort-by=facilities.distance&date-min=2026-02-07&date-max=2026-02-07&proximity=35&expand=RatingSummary&trade-only=false&take=10&latitude=28.4258547&longitude=-81.2408682&isSimulator=false|https://api.gnsvc.com/GolfNowAPI.svc/rest/channel/331/facility-summaries?q=geolocation&skip=0&sort-by=facilities.distance&date-min=2026-02-07&date-max=2026-02-07&proximity=35&expand=RatingSummary&trade-only=false&take=10&latitude=28.4258547&longitude=-81.2408682&isSimulator=false] 
* !image-20260304-194638.png|width=625,alt="image-20260304-194638.png"!
** The above is the base API call that will get unfiltered facilities by the basic requirements to search assuming the user does not specify anything 
** Take up to 10 facilities
** Potential Parameters to append based on prompts
*** {{&trade-only=true}} If the prompt mentions Hot Deals or best deals
*** {{&price-min}} or {{&price-max}} if the prompt mentions price restrictions
*** {{&time-min}} or {{&time-max}} if the prompt mentions time restrictions
*** {{&holes}} if the prompt mentions they number of holes they are looking for. The default should be 18
*** {{&players}} if the prompt mentions the number of players they have. The default should be 1
*** {{&isSimulator=true}}if the prompt mentions indoor golf, simulators or driving ranges
*** {{&sort-by=facilities.rating}}and {{&sort-direction=desc}} if the prompt mentions sorting by highest rated or top rated
*** {{&sorty-by=GreenFees}} and {{&sort-direction=asc or desc}} if the prompt mentions sorting by lowest or highest price
** Expose {{FeeMessagingFacilityDisplayRates}} object
*** UI team will use this object for price ranges and fee message text at the top of the widget
*** If NULL, they will not display the message and use the standard API fields for the display
** Expose the {{IsSimulator}} field so UI can badge facilities appropriately
* {color:#ff5630}Call this API to get a sample of tee times at each FacilityId from the above: {{prod-api-base-url}}/GolfNowAPI.svc/rest/channel/331/facilities/4356/tee-times?skip=0&take=100&trade-only=false&date-min=2026-02-17&date-max=2026-02-17{color}
** {color:#ff5630}The above is the base API call that will get unfiltered tee times per facility by the basic requirements to search assuming the user does not specify anything{color}
** {color:#ff5630}Display 3 tee time tiles{color}
** {color:#ff5630}Prioritize Hot Deals if no specific filter would block those out{color}
** {color:#ff5630}If there are not 3 Hot Deals, fill the open spots with Course Times{color}
*** {color:#ff5630}The tee times should match the prompted filters {color}
**** {color:#ff5630}if they prompt for 9 holes, display the 9 hole tee times{color}
**** {color:#ff5630}if they prompt for afternoon tee times, display the afternoon tee times {color}
** {color:#ff5630}Potential Parameters to append based on prompts{color}
*** {{&trade-only=true}}{color:#ff5630} If the prompt mentions Hot Deals or best deals{color}
*** {{&price-min}}{color:#ff5630} or {color}{{&price-max}}{color:#ff5630} if the prompt mentions price restrictions{color}
*** {{&time-min}}{color:#ff5630} or {color}{{&time-max}}{color:#ff5630} if the prompt mentions time restrictions{color}
*** {{&holes}}{color:#ff5630} if the prompt mentions they number of holes they are looking for {color}
*** {{&players}}{color:#ff5630} if the prompt mentions the number of players they have{color}
*** {{&sorty-by=GreenFees}}{color:#ff5630} and {color}{{&sort-direction=asc or desc}}{color:#ff5630} if the prompt mentions sorting by lowest or highest price{color}
* Tool Description:
** Returns a list of golf facilities with available tee times for display in search results.
Each result combines *facility summary data* (name, location, distance, rating) with *near-term tee time offers* (time, price, holes, player count, deal flags).
This tool supports location-based searches using a city, area, or the user’s current location, and allows filtering and sorting by distance, date, time window, number of holes, players, price, rating, and deal types.
Use this tool whenever a user asks to find, browse, or compare golf courses or tee times in a specific area or near them.
* Associated UI: Picture above

*Testing:*

We need the ability for a ChatGPT user to:

* Prompt by lat/long, zip code, city, direct course name or geographical area and have facilities that return
** Show me available tee times near my house (assuming they have allowed location services and the browser has the lat/long)
** Show me available tee times in 32832
** Show me available tee times at Dubsdread golf course
** Show me available tee times in central florida
** The word “tee time” could be replaced with “golf course(s)” or “course(s)”
* Prompt by the above but with a date or date range
** Show me tee times for tomorrow
** Show me tee times for the next week
* The results should return Facility Name, Address, Summary info like Earliest/Latest Tee Time, Min/Max Price, IsSimulator
* Results should default to filtering by distance from the location based search term ascending
** If a prompt uses words like “Best” or “Highest Rated”, we should filter using our Rating filter descending
** If the prompt uses words like “By Price” or “Cheapest”, we should filter using our price filter ascending 
* If no date is provided in the prompt
** Default to today’s tee times
** If it is after 2pm, display tomorrow’s tee times
* Default radius should be 35 miles
* Default facility results limit to 10
** If a user asks for more results, submit another batch of 10
* Clicking on a button should deeplink the user to the facility page UI 
** [https://www.golfnow.com/tee-times/facility/19058-brookside-at-the-rose-bowl-eo-nay/search|https://www.golfnow.com/tee-times/facility/19058-brookside-at-the-rose-bowl-eo-nay/search] 
** append a {{utm_source=chatgptapp}} to all links so page views can be tracked with analytics and we can create a cookie
* As a fallback, if a prompt is not recognized, display fallback copy: TBD



Repo: [https://github.com/GolfNowEng/golf-web-openai|https://github.com/GolfNowEng/golf-web-openai|smart-link]

* Call this API to get the facility results and info: [https://api.gnsvc.com/GolfNowAPI.svc/rest/channel/331/facility-summaries?q=geolocation&skip=0&sort-by=facilities.distance&date-min=2026-02-07&date-max=2026-02-07&proximity=35&expand=RatingSummary&trade-only=false&take=10&latitude=28.4258547&longitude=-81.2408682&isSimulator=false|https://api.gnsvc.com/GolfNowAPI.svc/rest/channel/331/facility-summaries?q=geolocation&skip=0&sort-by=facilities.distance&date-min=2026-02-07&date-max=2026-02-07&proximity=35&expand=RatingSummary&trade-only=false&take=10&latitude=28.4258547&longitude=-81.2408682&isSimulator=false]
* !image-20260304-194638.png|width=625,alt="image-20260304-194638.png"!
** The above is the base API call that will get unfiltered facilities by the basic requirements to search assuming the user does not specify anything
** Take up to 10 facilities
** Potential Parameters to append based on prompts
*** {{&trade-only=true}} If the prompt mentions Hot Deals or best deals
*** {{&price-min}} or {{&price-max}} if the prompt mentions price restrictions
*** {{&time-min}} or {{&time-max}} if the prompt mentions time restrictions
*** {{&holes}} if the prompt mentions they number of holes they are looking for. The default should be 18
*** {{&players}} if the prompt mentions the number of players they have. The default should be 1
*** {{&isSimulator=true}}r driving rangesif the prompt mentions indoor golf, simulators o
*** {{&sort-by=facilities.rating}}and {{&sort-direction=desc}} if the prompt mentions sorting by highest rated or top rated
*** {{&sorty-by=GreenFees}} and {{&sort-direction=asc or desc}} if the prompt mentions sorting by lowest or highest price
** Expose {{FeeMessagingFacilityDisplayRates}} object
*** UI team will use this object for price ranges and fee message text at the top of the widget
*** If NULL, they will not display the message and use the standard API fields for the display
** Expose the {{IsSimulator}} field so UI can badge facilities appropriately
* Call this API to get a sample of tee times at each FacilityId from the above: {{prod-api-base-url}}/GolfNowAPI.svc/rest/channel/331/facilities/4356/tee-times?skip=0&take=100&trade-only=false&date-min=2026-02-17&date-max=2026-02-17
** The above is the base API call that will get unfiltered tee times per facility by the basic requirements to search assuming the user does not specify anything
** Display 3 tee time tiles
** Prioritize Hot Deals if no specific filter would block those out
** If there are not 3 Hot Deals, fill the open spots with Course Times
*** The tee times should match the prompted filters
**** if they prompt for 9 holes, display the 9 hole tee times
**** if they prompt for afternoon tee times, display the afternoon tee times
** Potential Parameters to append based on prompts
*** {{&trade-only=true}} If the prompt mentions Hot Deals or best deals
*** {{&price-min}} or {{&price-max}} if the prompt mentions price restrictions
*** {{&time-min}} or {{&time-max}} if the prompt mentions time restrictions
*** {{&holes}} if the prompt mentions they number of holes they are looking for
*** {{&players}} if the prompt mentions the number of players they have
*** {{&sorty-by=GreenFees}} and {{&sort-direction=asc or desc}} if the prompt mentions sorting by lowest or highest price
** Expose the {{IsSimulator}} field so UI can display tee times appropriately
*** Expose {{Duration}}
** Expose {{HasMoreRates}} so the UI knows when to expand to show related rates
** Expose {{FeeMessagingFacilityDisplayRates}} object
*** UI team will use this object for price details with fee included and fee message breakdown text
*** If NULL, they will not display the message and use the standard API fields for the display
* Tool Description:
** Returns a list of golf facilities with available tee times for display in search results.
Each result combines *facility summary data* (name, location, distance, rating) with *near-term tee time offers* (time, price, holes, player count, deal flags).
This tool supports location-based searches using a city, area, or the user’s current location, and allows filtering and sorting by distance, date, time window, number of holes, players, price, rating, and deal types.
Use this tool whenever a user asks to find, browse, or compare golf courses or tee times in a specific area or near them.
* Associated UI: Picture above

*Testing:*

We need the ability for a ChatGPT user to:

* Prompt by lat/long, zip code, city, direct course name or geographical area and have facilities that return
** Show me available tee times near my house (assuming they have allowed location services and the browser has the lat/long)
** Show me available tee times in 32832
** Show me available tee times at Dubsdread golf course
** Show me available tee times in central florida
** The word “tee time” could be replaced with “golf course(s)” or “course(s)”
* Prompt by the above but with a date or date range
** Show me tee times for tomorrow
** Show me tee times for the next week
* The results should return Facility Name, Address, Summary info like Earliest/Latest Tee Time, Min/Max Price, IsSimulator
* Results should default to filtering by distance from the location based search term ascending
** If a prompt uses words like “Best” or “Highest Rated”, we should filter using our Rating filter descending
** If the prompt uses words like “By Price” or “Cheapest”, we should filter using our price filter ascending
* If no date is provided in the prompt
** Default to today’s tee times
** If it is after 2pm, display tomorrow’s tee times
* Default radius should be 35 miles
* Default facility results limit to 10
** If a user asks for more results, submit another batch of 10
* Clicking on a button should deeplink the user to the facility page UI
** [https://www.golfnow.com/tee-times/facility/19058-brookside-at-the-rose-bowl-eo-nay/search|https://www.golfnow.com/tee-times/facility/19058-brookside-at-the-rose-bowl-eo-nay/search|smart-link]
** append a {{utm_source=chatgptapp}} to all links so page views can be tracked with analytics and we can create a cookie
* As a fallback, if a prompt is not recognized, display fallback copy: TBD

Repo: [https://github.com/GolfNowEng/golf-web-openai|https://github.com/GolfNowEng/golf-web-openai|smart-link]

issues.description:
This ticket was originally worked on in [https://golfnow.atlassian.net/browse/CORE-13275|https://golfnow.atlassian.net/browse/CORE-13275|smart-link]  but it does not look to be working in prod. We need to revisit this and confirm we have this working. Below is the cloned details from the original ticket.

----

We have a request from the business to allow EZTP to create RackTimes at $0 for member rates. In this case, tee times should be blocked based on the player rule, not the price. Additionally, Tee Sheet Pricing should not affect the expected behavior.



*Example 1:*

* Tee Sheet Pricing is enabled
** RackTime is sent to us with a price = $0 and at least one player availability
*** RackTime should be left *unblocked*
** RackTime is sent to us with a price = $0 and there is zero player availability
*** RackTime should be *blocked*
** RackTime is sent to us with a price > $0 and at least one player availability
*** RackTime should be left *unblocked*
** RackTime is sent to us with a price > $0 and there is zero player availability
*** RackTime should be *blocked*

*Example 2:* 

* Tee Sheet Pricing is disabled
** RackTime is sent to us with a price = $0 and at least one player availability
*** RackTime should be left *unblocked*
** RackTime is sent to us with a price = $0 and there is zero player availability
*** RackTime should be *blocked*
** RackTime is sent to us with a price > $0 and at least one player availability
*** RackTime should be left *unblocked*
** RackTime is sent to us with a price > $0 and there is zero player availability
*** RackTime should be *blocked*



*QA:* 

* Please coordinate with EZL team and ask them to send in a $0 member rate with at least one available player, as well as a $0 member rate with zero player availability
* Please test both Tee Sheet Pricing scenarios (enabled vs disabled)
* Please test rates equal to $0, as well as rates greater than $0
* As with all EZL tickets, full regressions ezl bookings

comments.author: Joshua Marquess
comments.body:
Root Cause Analysis Complete - $0 Rack Time Filtering

Deep code trace completed across the full search-to-booking pipeline. Root cause confirmed with 100% confidence.

---
PRIMARY ROOT CAUSE: Stored Procedure [Inventory].[GetRackTimes]

The WHERE clause contains hardcoded filters that explicitly exclude $0 rates at the database level:

AND rt.RTRule > 0
AND rt.RTValueRate > 0
AND rt.RTBaseSpecialRate > 0

`AND rt.RTBaseSpecialRate > 0` is the line that kills $0 member rates. The rack time never reaches the C# application code -- it's excluded at the SQL level before the Inventory WCF service returns results.

This proc is called by [Inventory].[GetTeeTimesUsingRateSets] which is the main search path.

---
SECONDARY ROOT CAUSE: C# Booking Path Gates

Even if the SQL filter is fixed, two C# gates block $0 rack time bookings:

1. `InvoiceService.cs` (lines 117-131):

if (criterion is RackTimeCriterion)
{
if (invoices.Any(i => i.ValueRate <= decimal.Zero || i.SpecialRate <= decimal.Zero))
throw new BusinessException(BusinessErrorCode.InvalidTeeTimeData, ...);
}

2. `InventoryChannel.cs` (lines 1697-1713):

Same check in an alternate booking path, returns Error result instead of throwing.

The developer comment in InvoiceService confirms: "the saving of this rack time to CRMTeeTime is going to fail" -- indicating a downstream DB constraint also needs addressing.

---
FIX REQUIRED (Three layers):

- Database: Modify [Inventory].[GetRackTimes] WHERE clause to allow RTBaseSpecialRate = 0 and RTValueRate = 0. Must also guard the commission calculation against divide-by-zero.

- C# Booking Path: Remove/modify the zero-rate guards in InvoiceService.cs:117-131 and InventoryChannel.cs:1697-1713 for legitimate $0 member rates.

- CRM Materialization: Verify procINSCRMTeeTime can handle $0 values (the InvoiceService comment says it will fail).

- Pricing Display: Review Extensions.cs:76-78 where $0 base rate gets a fabricated 1-cent value rate adjustment.

---
What Was Ruled Out:

- TeeTimeRulesHandler: All rules are commented out in DI registration (no-op)

comments.bodyHtml:
Root Cause Analysis Complete - $0 Rack Time Filtering

Deep code trace completed across the full search-to-booking pipeline. Root cause confirmed with 100% confidence.

PRIMARY ROOT CAUSE: Stored Procedure [Inventory].[GetRackTimes]

The WHERE clause contains hardcoded filters that explicitly exclude $0 rates at the database level:

AND rt.RTRule > 0
AND rt.RTValueRate > 0
AND rt.RTBaseSpecialRate > 0

`AND rt.RTBaseSpecialRate > 0` is the line that kills $0 member rates. The rack time never reaches the C# application code -- it's excluded at the SQL level before the Inventory WCF service returns results.

This proc is called by [Inventory].[GetTeeTimesUsingRateSets] which is the main search path.

SECONDARY ROOT CAUSE: C# Booking Path Gates

Even if the SQL filter is fixed, two C# gates block $0 rack time bookings:

1. `InvoiceService.cs` (lines 117-131):

if (criterion is RackTimeCriterion)
{
    if (invoices.Any(i => i.ValueRate <= decimal.Zero || i.SpecialRate <= decimal.Zero))
        throw new BusinessException(BusinessErrorCode.InvalidTeeTimeData, ...);
}

2. `InventoryChannel.cs` (lines 1697-1713):

Same check in an alternate booking path, returns Error result instead of throwing.

The developer comment in InvoiceService confirms: "the saving of this rack time to CRMTeeTime is going to fail" -- indicating a downstream DB constraint also needs addressing.

FIX REQUIRED (Three layers):

  1. Database: Modify [Inventory].[GetRackTimes] WHERE clause to allow RTBaseSpecialRate = 0 and RTValueRate = 0. Must also guard the commission calculation against divide-by-zero.

  1. C# Booking Path: Remove/modify the zero-rate guards in InvoiceService.cs:117-131 and InventoryChannel.cs:1697-1713 for legitimate $0 member rates.

  1. CRM Materialization: Verify procINSCRMTeeTime can handle $0 values (the InvoiceService comment says it will fail).

  1. Pricing Display: Review Extensions.cs:76-78 where $0 base rate gets a fabricated 1-cent value rate adjustment.

What Was Ruled Out:

  • TeeTimeRulesHandler: All rules are commented out in DI registration (no-op)

  • RemoveInvalidRates: Only activates with explicit price filter from consumer (default is null/no-op)

  • CreateTeeTime/ProcessTeeTimes: No price-based filtering

  • @PriceStart parameter: Defaults to null, proc defaults to 0.00 floor which includes $0

A full technical reference document has been prepared with complete file paths, line numbers, pipeline trace, fix implementation plan, and verification queries. Available for the assigned developer.

issues.summary: Platform Docs Site Setup
issues.description:
h2. Background

We have historically struggled to maintain clear and useful API documentation for external partners (and even internal folks). To remedy this, we will begin deployment of an [https://www.mkdocs.org/|https://www.mkdocs.org/|smart-link] based website that will host API reference material for teams to integrate with.

h2. User Story

As a GolfNow developer, I want to be able to write API documentation for projects such as the Order Processing API or Inventory API in order to support integration with our API platform.

h2. Tasks

# Setup a repo, {{gn-docs-platform}} and configure an mkdocs instance with a theme.
# Develop an organization scheme for the docs site, we will want to cover the following scopes:
## Authorization / Authentication (using gn-svc-auth and specifically our Platform Principal system)
## Inventory API
## Order Processing API
## Customer Graph API
# Each API needs to support versioning, so the folder structure should be something like:
## Inventory API
### v1
#### Tee Times
#### Club Fitting
#### Subscriptions
### v2
#### Etc
# Apply GolfNow brand colors to site
## See [^GN Style Guide.pdf]

issues.summary: Geosearch2.0 : optimization
issues.description:
We were seeing some higher memory usage in mongodb cluster that could be due to higher traffic. However we will investigate any query / index optimization that we can do to lower the memory usage.

!image-20260408-162939.png|width=787,alt="image-20260408-162939.png"!

{noformat}# Search Page Faults Optimization

## Context
- Node1 memory elevation causing Search Page Faults spike
- 2.5M GeoLocation records, 29K PointOfInterest records
- Indexes: LOCATION_SEARCH_KEY_V2, POI_KEY_SEARCH_V2

## Tasks

### 1. [ ] Cap `take` parameter on GeoplacesController
- **File:** `Geosearch.API/Controllers/V1/GeoplacesController.cs`
- **Endpoints:** `/geoplaces/lookup` (line 55), `/geoplaces/city` (line 172)
- **Change:** Add `take = Math.Clamp(take, 1, 50)` at the top of both methods
- **Impact:** Prevents unbounded Atlas Search scans from a single request
- **Requires:** Code change only (no index rebuild)

### 2. [ ] Raise `minGrams` from 1 to 3 on autocomplete fields
- **Indexes:** `LOCATION_SEARCH_KEY_V2` (Name, Names, Admin1Name), `POI_KEY_SEARCH_V2` (Name, SearchKey)
- **Change:** `minGrams: 1` → `minGrams: 3` on all autocomplete fields
- **Impact:** ~40-60% reduction in search index size; eliminates single/double char gram explosion
- **Tradeoff:** Autocomplete won't return results until user types 3+ characters
- **Requires:** Index rebuild

### 3. [ ] Merge dual parallel Location aggregations into single query
- **File:** `Geosearch.Repository.Mongo/Repositories/GeoLocationRepository.cs` (lines 132-192)
- **Current:** Two `$search` aggregations run via `Task.WhenAll()` (location + postal), then merge/re-sort in memory
- **Change:** Combine into single `$search` compound query with `should` clauses for both postal and non-postal matches
- **Impact:** Halves concurrent index segment reads per request; reduces page fault pressure
- **Requires:** Code change only (no index rebuild)

### 4. [ ] Reduce `maxExpansions` from 50 to 20
- **Files:**
  - `Geosearch.Repository.Mongo/Helpers/PoiQueryDefinitionHelper.cs` — 3 usages (TextSearchInACircle, TextSearchWithNear)
  - `Geosearch.Repository.Mongo/Helpers/LocationQueryDefinitionHelper.cs` — 3 usages (TextSearchWithNear, PostalCodeSearchWithNear, TextSearchWithNearByCity)
- **Change:** `maxExpansions: 50` → `maxExpansions: 20` in all fuzzy configurations
- **Impact:** Fewer fuzzy variants per query = fewer index segment reads; minor tradeoff on typo tolerance
- **Requires:** Code change only (no index rebuild)

### 5. [ ] Add `.Limit()` and projections to unbounded POI queries
- **File:** `Geosearch.Repository.Mongo/Repositories/PointOfInterestRepository.cs`
- **Methods:**
  - `FindPointOfInterestByAddressAndLocation` — no `.Limit()`, no projection, returns full documents
  - `GetPointOfInterests(long[] ids)` — no `.Limit()`, no projection
- **Change:** Add reasonable `.Limit()` and projections to both methods
- **Impact:** Prevents unexpected large result sets from consuming memory
- **Requires:** Code change only (no index rebuild)

### 6. [ ] Reduce `maxGrams` from 10 to 7 on autocomplete fields
- **Indexes:** `LOCATION_SEARCH_KEY_V2` (Name, Names, Admin1Name, PostalCode), `POI_KEY_SEARCH_V2` (Name, SearchKey)
- **Change:** `maxGrams: 10` → `maxGrams: 7` on all autocomplete fields
- **Impact:** ~30% fewer stored grams per term; minimal user-facing impact since longer prefixes handled by `string` type mappings
- **Requires:** Index rebuild{noformat}

issues.summary: Support GolfPass Cancellations
issues.description:
In order to meet compliance for price increased products, we will need to expose a subscription cancellation option in the Membership Settings page. This cancellation option will be conditional based on some API attributes.

- Design: https://www.figma.com/design/n4GhZL6oXgfk93DFUhn98h/Cancel-membership-button?node-id=373-19485&m=dev

- We need to make a copy change that is different from the design

- Current: Cancel your GolfPass+ Membership subscription immediately and get a full refund for the renewal period.

- Change to: Cancel your GolfPass+ Membership subscription immediately and get a full refund for the subscription period.

- APIs

- Eligibility API - GET {{prod-api-base-url}}/GolfNowAPI.svc/rest/channel/{{ChannelId}}/customers/{{EmailAddress}}/subscriptions?productTypeId=9

- Target Field: IsEligibleForCancellation

- Cancel/Refund API: POST {{prod-api-base-url}}/GolfNowAPI.svc/rest/channel/{{ChannelId}}/customers/{{EmailAddress}}/subscriptions/{{CustomerSubscriptionId}}/cancelWithRefund

- CustomerSubscriptionId is found in the first endpoint

- Request Body:

{
"CancellationReasonId": 1,
"CancelEvenIfBenefitsUsed": true,
"RefundType": 1,
"SystemUserId": 1
}

- Always pass in CancellationReasonId = 1

- This means “Too Expensive”

- Always pass in CancelEvenIfBenefitsUsed = true

- Always Pass in RefundType = 0

- This means “Full Refund”

- Always pass in SystemUserId = 1

- Logic

- If IsEligibleForCancellation = true

- Display the Cancel Subscription option

- Tapping the button should open a bottom sheet with the option to confirm

- Confirming should submit the Cancel/Refund API above

- Membership settings should reload the page with the “No active memberships” treatment and we should make sure we resubmit any customer data in the app to make sure they are no longer recognized as a GP Member

- Remove the PASS, show the non member version of member hub, etc

- Currently this page is only accessible for members so a part of this work will be to make this Membership Settings page visible for all users

- Non members will simply see the no memberships version in the design

- To display the recently expired/cancelled subscription info, you can add these to the Get Subscription API: &cancelledIncluded=true&expiredIncluded=true

- If you have an expired or canceled membership and no active memberships, display the following message below the header:

- Your GolfPass membership has ended

- This is not reflected in the design so please use ^^Change the copy in this box from the design

- If IsEligibleForCancellation = false

- Do not show the Cancel Subscription option and the page will remain as is

- For the GolfPass CTA when you are not a member, link to the following product

- GN US/TO Prod: /7129411482949

- QA: /7129410862949

- GN UK Prod: /4929411702949

- QA: /492946602949

- GN AU Prod: /4529411712949

- QA: /452941462949

- Testing

- Most of the test cases are listed https://golfnow.atlassian.net/browse/CORE-14272

- Happy Path

- Create a user with a State of New York and billing address also in New York

- Buy one of the $119 free trial products

- Renew into the paid $119 product

- The IsEligibleForCancellation should be true as long as today’s date is within 15 days of the renewal date

- The Cancel Option should show

issues.summary: Support GolfPass Cancellations
issues.description:
In order to meet compliance for price increased products, we will need to expose a subscription cancellation option in the Membership Settings page. This cancellation option will be conditional based on some API attributes. This applies to the GN Membership Settings as well as the GolfPass White Label Membership Settings.

- Design: https://www.figma.com/design/n4GhZL6oXgfk93DFUhn98h/Cancel-membership-button?node-id=246-46405&m=dev#1745521556

- Pay attention to the Automatic Renewal label copy that is changing as well as the subtext paragraph

- We need to make a copy change that is different from the design

- Current: Cancel your GolfPass+ Membership subscription immediately and get a full refund for the renewal period.

- Change to: Cancel your GolfPass+ Membership subscription immediately and get a full refund for the subscription period.

- APIs

- Eligibility API - GET {{prod-api-base-url}}/GolfNowAPI.svc/rest/channel/{{ChannelId}}/customers/{{EmailAddress}}/subscriptions?productTypeId=9

- Target Field: IsEligibleForCancellation

- Cancel/Refund API: POST {{prod-api-base-url}}/GolfNowAPI.svc/rest/channel/{{ChannelId}}/customers/{{EmailAddress}}/subscriptions/{{CustomerSubscriptionId}}/cancelWithRefund

- CustomerSubscriptionId is found in the first endpoint

- Request Body:

{
"CancellationReasonId": 1,
"CancelEvenIfBenefitsUsed": true,
"RefundType": 1,
"SystemUserId": 1
}

- Always pass in CancellationReasonId = 1

- This means “Too Expensive”

- Always pass in CancelEvenIfBenefitsUsed = true

- Always Pass in RefundType = 0

- This means “Full Refund”

- Always pass in SystemUserId = 1

- Logic

- If IsEligibleForCancellation = true

- Display the Cancel Subscription option

- Tapping the button should open a modal with the option to confirm

- Confirming should submit the Cancel/Refund API above

- Membership settings should reload the page with the “No active memberships” treatment and we should make sure we resubmit any customer data in the site to make sure they are no longer recognized as a GP Member

- Remove the GP icons under their name, show the non member version of various pages, etc

- Currently this page is only accessible for members so a part of this work will be to make this Membership Settings page visible for all users

- Non members will simply see the no memberships version in the design

- To display the recently expired/cancelled subscription info, you can add these to the Get Subscription API: &cancelledIncluded=true&expiredIncluded=true

- If you have an expired or canceled membership and no active memberships, display the following message below the header:

- Your GolfPass membership has ended

- This is not reflected in the design so please use ^^

- If IsEligibleForCancellation = false

- Do not show the Cancel Subscription option and the page will remain as is

- For the GolfPass CTA when you are not a member, link to the following product

- GN US/TO Prod: /7129411482949

- QA: /7129410862949

- GN UK Prod: /4929411702949

- QA: /492941422949

- GN AU Prod: /4529411712949

- QA: /452941462949

- Most of the test cases are listed https://golfnow.atlassian.net/browse/CORE-14272

- Happy Path

- Create a user with a State of New York and billing address also in New York

- Buy one of the $119 free trial products

- Renew into the paid $119 product

- The IsEligibleForCancellation should be true as long as today’s date is within 15 days of the renewal date

- The Cancel Option should show

issues.summary: GolfPass Waiver: Partial Fee Waiver Based on IsWaivable Flag
issues.description:
GOAL

Update the GolfPass loyalty waiver logic so that only fees marked as waivable (IsWaivable = true) are waived, rather than the current all-or-nothing behavior that zeroes out the entire transaction fee total.

---
Summary

Today, when a GolfPass member qualifies for a transaction fee waiver, ApplyGoodwillActivity wipes the full transaction fee subtotal regardless of fee type. With the new FeeConfiguration system (CORE-14444/CORE-14510), each fee type now carries an IsWaivable flag at the database and DTO level.

This ticket introduces partial waiver behavior:

- Only the portion of the transaction fee that comes from waivable fee configurations gets zeroed

- Non-waivable fees remain charged on the invoice

- The discount record reflects only the actually-waived amount

This ticket also includes the "bridge" work to expose individual FeeConfiguration objects (with their IsWaivable flags) through FeeContextConfiguration to the invoice workflow, since today only an aggregate TransactionFeeTotal decimal crosses that boundary.

Acceptance Criteria

- GP-eligible customers only have waivable fee amounts removed from their transaction fee line item

- Non-waivable fee amounts remain on the invoice unchanged

- The discount record (DiscountType.FrequentGolfer) reflects only the waived portion

- Feature-flagged behind IsFeeConfigurationEnabled; legacy path unchanged

- Existing unit tests pass; new tests cover partial waiver scenarios

Key Integration Points

- ApplyGoodwillActivity (Invoice workflow)

- FeeContextConfiguration / FeeCalculationService (bridge work)

- LoyaltyHelper.IsTransactionFeeWaived()

- IFeeConfigurationDal (already DI-registered via RevenueHelper)

Dependencies

- CORE-14510 must be merged first

---
Technical Findings

See attached MD file for full code-trace details including current state analysis, structural gap explanation, key class locations, DI registration info, and the discount record pattern.

comments.author: Joshua Marquess
comments.body:
Technical Findings: GP Waiver - Partial Fee Waiver Integration

Current State (All-or-Nothing Waiver)

The GolfPass transaction fee waiver currently works as a single all-or-nothing operation:

- ApplyGoodwillActivity.Process(InvoiceState state) calls this.loyaltyHelper.IsTransactionFeeWaived(state.Customer.CustomerID)

- If true, it iterates state.Items and for each item where item.PricingEntity.IsLoyaltyEnabled:

- Finds the transaction fee invoice detail (both old TransactionFeeInvoiceItemDetail and new GenericFeeInvoiceItemDetail paths)

- Calls AdjustSubtotal(-amount) with the FULL subtotal, zeroing the entire fee

- Records a PromoCodeDiscount with DiscountType = DiscountType.FrequentGolfer

Location: GolfNow.Services.Reservation.Provider/Workflow/Invoice/ApplyGoodwillActivity.cs

The Structural Gap

FeeContextConfiguration (the application-layer object that feeds fee totals into the invoice) only exposes an aggregated TransactionFeeTotal decimal. The individual FeeConfiguration objects (each now carrying IsWaivable from CORE-14510) are private within FeeContextConfiguration and do not cross into the invoice workflow.

This means the waiver logic today has no way to know which portion of the fee total is waivable vs. non-waivable. The "bridge" work to expose per-fee-configuration granularity is in scope for this ticket.

Key Classes and Files

Component

Location

Role

ApplyGoodwillActivity

Provider/Workflow/Invoice/ApplyGoodwillActivity.cs

Applies the waiver (behavior changes here)

LoyaltyHelper

Provider/Loyalty/LoyaltyHelper.cs

Determines GP waiver eligibility

FeeContextConfiguration

Framework.Pricing.Fees

Holds fee configs; today only exposes aggregate total

FeeCalculationService

Framework.Pricing.Fees

Applies transaction fees; consumes FeeContextConfiguration

GenericFeeInvoiceItemDetail

Framework.Pricing/Model/Invoices/

Invoice line item wrapping a single FeeAllotmentDetail

CommonHelper.GetTransactionFeeInvoiceItem()

Provider/Misc/CommonHelper.cs

Locates the transaction fee line item in invoice details

IFeeConfigurationDal

Framework.Pricing.Fees.Data.DAL

Data access for fee configurations (already DI-registered)

Feature Flag

All new behavior must be gated behind Misc.CommonHelper.IsFeeConfigurationEnabled() (maps to AppSetting IsFeeConfigurationEnabled). The legacy TransactionFeeInvoiceItemDetail path remains untouched.

Business Rule (Confirmed)

Partial waiver: only the waivable portion gets zeroed. Non-waivable fees remain on the invoice. The discount record should reflect only the waived amount.

DI Registration

RevenueHelper (which wraps IFeeConfigurationDal) is already registered in Autofac at Modules/ReservationHostFactory.cs:173:

builder.RegisterType<RevenueHelper>().As<IRevenueHelper>();

No new DI registration should be needed to access fee configuration data from within the invoice workflow.

Discount Record Pattern

The existing discount uses:

- PromoCode = ReservationDiscount.PROMO_CODE_WAIVED_TRANSACTION_FEE

- DiscountType = DiscountType.FrequentGolfer

- TransactionFeeDiscount = amount (today: full amount; after this ticket: waivable portion only)

What NOT to Change

- The eligibility check (IsTransactionFeeWaived) stays boolean (you either qualify or you don't)

- The IsLoyaltyEnabled per-pricing-entity gate stays as-is

- The legacy (non-FeeConfiguration) path remains all-or-nothing

issues.summary: Home Course Earn Multiplier
issues.description:
We need to add a new loyalty points earn multiplier that will be awarded when a user selects a home course.

Requirements:

- Name: Home Course

- Description: Home course members multiplier

- Support a flat points addition or a percentage points multiplier

- Example 1: Home course members receive 2000 additional points.

- Example 2: Home course members receive 2x more points.

- NOTE: This should be a configurable database value

- Eligibility:

- Anybody who has an active product subscription of a product with BenefitID X

- Home course selected

- Tee time booked at home course

- TotalPromotionalEarnablePoints

- Include this home course multiplier points total in TotalPromotionalEarnablePoints field in the LoyaltyEligibility object on the invoice, purchase response, and reservation details

- Example 1 - Customer is receiving the home course multiplier points

- Customer earns 3000 points as part of the standard loyalty multiplier

- Customer earns 200 additional points as part of the home course multiplier

- Old Behavior (DO NOT USE):

- "TotalBaseEarnablePoints": 3000,
"TotalEarnablePoints": 3200,
"TotalPromotionalEarnablePoints": 3200

- New Behavior (USE):

- "TotalBaseEarnablePoints": 3000,
"TotalEarnablePoints": 3200,
"TotalPromotionalEarnablePoints": 0 or NULL
"TotalHomeCourseEarnablePoints": 200

- Example 2 - Customer is not receiving the home course multiplier points

- Customer earns 3000 points as part of the standard loyalty multiplier

- Customer does not earn the additional 200 home course multiplier points

- "TotalBaseEarnablePoints": 3000,
"TotalEarnablePoints": 3000,
"TotalPromotionalEarnablePoints": 0 or NULL,
"TotalHomeCourseEarnablePoints": 0 or NULL

- Example 3 - Customer is  receiving the home course multiplier points AND there is a 2x promotion

- Customer earns 3000 points as part of the standard loyalty multiplier

- Customer earns 2x for base points

- Customer earns the additional 200 home course multiplier points

- "TotalBaseEarnablePoints": 3000,
"TotalEarnablePoints": 6200,
"TotalPromotionalEarnablePoints": 3000,
"TotalHomeCourseEarnablePoints": 200

issues.descriptionHtml:
We need to add a new loyalty points earn multiplier that will be awarded when a user selects a home course.

Requirements:

  • Name: Home Course

  • Description: Home course members multiplier

  • Support a flat points addition or a percentage points multiplier

    • Example 1: Home course members receive 2000 additional points.

    • Example 2: Home course members receive 2x more points.

    • NOTE: This should be a configurable database value

  • Eligibility:

    • Anybody who has an active product subscription of a product with BenefitID X

    • Home course selected

    • Tee time booked at home course

  • TotalPromotionalEarnablePoints

    • Include this home course multiplier points total in TotalPromotionalEarnablePoints field in the LoyaltyEligibility object on the invoice, purchase response, and reservation details

      • Example 1 - Customer is receiving the home course multiplier points

        • Customer earns 3000 points as part of the standard loyalty multiplier

        • Customer earns 200 additional points as part of the home course multiplier

          • Old Behavior (DO NOT USE):

          • "TotalBaseEarnablePoints": 3000,
"TotalEarnablePoints": 3200,
"TotalPromotionalEarnablePoints": 3200

          • New Behavior (USE):

          • "TotalBaseEarnablePoints": 3000,
"TotalEarnablePoints": 3200,
"TotalPromotionalEarnablePoints": 0 or NULL
"TotalHomeCourseEarnablePoints": 200

      • Example 2 - Customer is not receiving the home course multiplier points

        • Customer earns 3000 points as part of the standard loyalty multiplier

        • Customer does not earn the additional 200 home course multiplier points

          • "TotalBaseEarnablePoints": 3000,
"TotalEarnablePoints": 3000,
"TotalPromotionalEarnablePoints": 0 or NULL,
"TotalHomeCourseEarnablePoints": 0 or NULL

      • Example 3 - Customer is receiving the home course multiplier points AND there is a 2x promotion

        • Customer earns 3000 points as part of the standard loyalty multiplier

        • Customer earns 2x for base points

        • Customer earns the additional 200 home course multiplier points

          • "TotalBaseEarnablePoints": 3000,
"TotalEarnablePoints": 6200,
"TotalPromotionalEarnablePoints": 3000,
"TotalHomeCourseEarnablePoints": 200

issues.summary: Home Course Suggestions API
issues.description:
We would like to have an API that returns a list of facilities that are suggested for a specific customer’s home course. This would be structured similar to our Get Facilities API but it will be authenticated, based on customer data and grouped into categories.

- API Request Structure

- Example possible URL: GET  /channel/{{ChannelID}}/facilities/{{EmailAddress}}/home-course-suggestions

- CustomerToken/AuthorizationToken

- &latitude=28.5383&longitude=-81.3792

- &take=10

- Support the many Expand options like &expand=RatingSummary|Facilities

- The ChannelId should support Channel Groups so if i book all my tee times on 331, if i am on the mobile app 5151, i should still see those results

- Reference Reservation data back to 1/1/2020

- If this is too much data, reference reservation data as far back as performance allows

- API Response Structure

- Facilities should be categorized

- Categories should have an ID just in case the UI wants to change the naming of the badge

- Most Played

- Return up to top 2 most played courses

- Tie breaker goes to played most recently

- If they have only have played 1 course, return just the one

- If they have no reservations or the reservation was for a facility that is now inactive, do not return any courses or hide the whole category

- Played Often

- Return up to 5 next most played courses

- Do not include courses that were in the Most Played object above

- If they have played less than 5 courses, return just the ones they have played

- If they have no reservations or the reservation was for a facility that is now inactive, do not return any courses or hide the whole category

- Tie breaker goes to played most recently

- Favorites

- Return all favorites assuming they are not listed in the previous two categories and are active facilities

- sort these by most played, then by closest

- Top Rated Nearby

- Any remaining in the list of the &take amount would be Top Rated courses near lat/long requested from browser/app

- Example: If i have only played two courses and no favorites but the take=10, display those two in Most Played and the other 8 would be nearby lat/long sorted by facilities.rating

- Fields under the categories should match the way the many /facilities responses we already have

- Match this response: {{prod-api-base-url}}/GolfNowAPI.svc/rest/channel/5151/facilities?q=geo-location&latitude=44.444686&longitude=-92.270174&proximity=100&expand=RatingSummary|Facilities

    1. Example possible URL: GET /channel/{{ChannelID}}/facilities/{{EmailAddress}}/home-course-suggestions

    2. CustomerToken/AuthorizationToken

    3. &latitude=28.5383&longitude=-81.3792

    4. &take=10

    5. Support the many Expand options like &expand=RatingSummary|Facilities

    6. The ChannelId should support Channel Groups so if i book all my tee times on 331, if i am on the mobile app 5151, i should still see those results

    7. Reference Reservation data back to 1/1/2020

      1. If this is too much data, reference reservation data as far back as performance allows

  2. API Response Structure

    1. Facilities should be categorized

    2. Categories should have an ID just in case the UI wants to change the naming of the badge

      1. Most Played

        1. Return up to top 2 most played courses

        2. Tie breaker goes to played most recently

        3. If they have only have played 1 course, return just the one

        4. If they have no reservations or the reservation was for a facility that is now inactive, do not return any courses or hide the whole category

      2. Played Often

        1. Return up to 5 next most played courses

        2. Do not include courses that were in the Most Played object above

        3. If they have played less than 5 courses, return just the ones they have played

        4. If they have no reservations or the reservation was for a facility that is now inactive, do not return any courses or hide the whole category

        5. Tie breaker goes to played most recently

      3. Favorites

        1. Return all favorites assuming they are not listed in the previous two categories and are active facilities

        2. sort these by most played, then by closest

      4. Top Rated Nearby

        1. Any remaining in the list of the &take amount would be Top Rated courses near lat/long requested from browser/app

      5. Example: If i have only played two courses and no favorites but the take=10, display those two in Most Played and the other 8 would be nearby lat/long sorted by facilities.rating

    3. Fields under the categories should match the way the many /facilities responses we already have

      1. Match this response: {{prod-api-base-url}}/GolfNowAPI.svc/rest/channel/5151/facilities?q=geo-location&latitude=44.444686&longitude=-92.270174&proximity=100&expand=RatingSummary|Facilities

issues.summary: Timelyst - QA testing
issues.description:
Overview

End-to-end QA testing of the Timelyst Inventory & Booking application. Many recent tickets involve foundational changes (refactoring, data schema migrations, architectural improvements) that are not individually QA-testable. Since Timelyst has no production traffic yet, this ticket consolidates full-stack validation into a single QA effort covering data sync, facility discovery, and booking workflows.

Environments:

- Timelyst API (Dev): https://timelyst.dev.golfnow.io

- Timelyst API (Stg): https://timelyst.stg.golfnow.io

- Hangfire Dashboard (Dev): timelyst-hangfire-dev.golfnowdmz.local/hangfire/recurring (accessible via AWS Workspace)

- Hangfire Dashboard (Stg): timelyst-hangfire-stg.golfnowdmz.local/hangfire/recurring (accessible via AWS Workspace)

- API Docs: Swagger / Scalar available at the API base URL

---
Test Steps

Step 1 — Configure Interface in CRM

- In the CRM database, create (or verify) an interface configuration for a golf course with a USC and/or CCH provider.

- Ensure the InterfaceAttribute collection has the correct API URL and credentials for the chosen provider(s).

- Note: CCH credentials are stored in the MongoDB InterfaceAttribute collection (synced from CRM via InterfaceAttributeSyncJob), NOT in GCCourseCode.

Step 2 — Wait for CRM → MongoDB Data Sync

- Wait approximately 1 hour for the recurring Hangfire jobs to auto-sync data from the CRM database to the MongoDB Timelyst database.

- Monitor sync progress on the Hangfire recurring jobs dashboard:
http://timelyst-hangfire-dev.golfnowdmz.local/hangfire/recurring

- Verify that Facility, Offering, Service, and InterfaceAttribute data has been synced into MongoDB.

NOTE: Full-sync jobs will attempt to fetch the full CRM table and sync into Mongo, which should be used for initialization. Incremental-sync jobs will only compare the TimeStamp field with the last sync time and only sync records with the updated TimeStamp field.

Step 3 — Create Interface Configuration via API

Using the Timelyst Management API, create interface configurations for USC and CCH providers (if they don't already exist from the sync).

Action

Method

Endpoint

List existing configs

GET

/api/v1/management/interfaceconfiguration

Create new config

POST

/api/v1/management/interfaceconfiguration

Get config by ID

GET

/api/v1/management/interfaceconfiguration/{id}

Update config

PUT

/api/v1/management/interfaceconfiguration/{id}

Delete config

DELETE

/api/v1/management/interfaceconfiguration/{id}

Validation: Confirm configs are created with correct provider type, facility mapping, and enabled status.

Step 4 — Create Product Verticals & Assign to Offerings

Product verticals classify offerings (e.g., "Golf", "Simulator", "Fitting"). The Value is auto-incremented — no need to pass it in the request body.

4a — Create Product Verticals

Action

Method

Endpoint

List product verticals

GET

/api/v1/management/productvertical

Get by ID

GET

/api/v1/management/productvertical/{id}

Create product vertical

POST

/api/v1/management/productvertical

Update product vertical

PUT

/api/v1/management/productvertical/{id}

Delete product vertical

DELETE

/api/v1/management/productvertical/{id}

Activate

POST

/api/v1/management/productvertical/{id}/activate

Deactivate

POST

/api/v1/management/productvertical/{id}/deactivate

Create request body: { "name": "Simulator" } (Value auto-assigned as max + 1)

Validation:

- Confirm Value is auto-incremented (1, 2, 3, ...)

- Confirm Name must be unique

- Confirm Value is immutable after creation (not editable via update)

4b — Assign Product Vertical to Offering

Assigns a product vertical to an existing offering using the ProductVertical's integer Value and the Offering's CRM GolfCourseID.

Action

Method

Endpoint

Assign to offering

POST

/api/v1/management/productvertical/{value}/assign/{offeringCrmId}

Example: POST /api/v1/management/productvertical/1/assign/12951

Validation:

- Confirm the response returns the updated OfferingDto with productVerticalType set

- Confirm assigning an inactive product vertical returns 400

- Confirm non-existent Value or CRM ID returns 404

- Verify the offering in MongoDB shows updated ProductVerticalType field

Step 5 — Create Service Categories & Assign to Services

Service categories use a power-of-2 bitmask pattern (CategoryId = 1, 2, 4, 8, 16...) to support multi-category assignment on services. Create categories first, then assign them to services synced in Step 2.

5a — Create Service Categories

Action

Method

Endpoint

List categories

GET

/api/v1/management/servicecategory

Get category by ID

GET

/api/v1/management/servicecategory/{id}

Create category

POST

/api/v1/management/servicecategory

Delete category

DELETE

/api/v1/management/servicecategory/{id}

Activate category

POST

/api/v1/management/servicecategory/{id}/activate

Deactivate category

POST

/api/v1/management/servicecategory/{id}/deactivate

Example: Create categories like "FullBag" (CategoryId=1), "Irons" (CategoryId=2), "Putter" (CategoryId=4).

Validation:

- Confirm CategoryId must be a unique power of 2

- Confirm Name must be unique

- Confirm categories cannot be modified after creation (immutable — only activate/deactivate/delete)

5b — Assign Categories to Services

Action

Method

Endpoint

Assign categories

POST

/api/v1/management/service/{id}/categories

Request body: { "serviceCategoryIds": [1, 2] }

Multiple categories are combined via OR bitmask (e.g., assigning IDs 1 & 2 sets CategoryId = 3, Category = "FullBag & Irons").

Validation:

- Confirm the service response shows the combined categoryId bitmask and concatenated category name

- Passing an empty array clears category assignments

- Verify assigned categories persist by re-fetching the service via GET /api/v1/management/service/{id}

Step 6 — Bootstrap & Run Reconciliation Jobs

- Trigger the cm-interface-config-bootstrap job in the Hangfire recurring jobs dashboard and refresh the page.

- Verify that two new recurring jobs are created: cm-recon-cch and cm-recon-usc.

- Run each cm-recon-* job. This should create facility-specific jobs following the pattern: cm-usc-f{facilityId}-c{courseId}-d{day}-{sequence} (e.g., cm-usc-f2134-c12951-d0-1).

- These jobs are only created if the CRM golf course is configured with the corresponding interface provider.

- Manually trigger these facility-specific jobs to sync inventory data with the upstream provider (Club Champion or USchedule).

- Verify that after the jobs complete, resource availability data is populated in MongoDB.

Step 7 — Rebuild Discovery Documents & Verify ServiceCategory in Search

After categories are assigned (Step 5) and inventory is synced (Step 6), trigger the Hangfire job that rebuilds the FacilityDiscovery documents so that category data is indexed for search.

- Trigger the facility-discovery-rebuild job (or equivalent) from the Hangfire dashboard.

- Verify the FacilityDiscovery documents in MongoDB contain ServiceCategoryIds arrays on the service entries:

- Each service should list the decomposed power-of-2 category IDs (e.g., bitmask 7 → [1, 2, 4])

- Test search with serviceCategoryIds filter:

#

Action

Method

Endpoint

Key Validations

1

Search by category

GET

/api/v1/channels/{channelId}/client/facilitydiscovery/search?serviceCategoryIds={id}

Only facilities with services matching the category are returned

2

Search by multiple categories

GET

/api/v1/channels/{channelId}/client/facilitydiscovery/search?serviceCategoryIds={id1}&serviceCategoryIds={id2}

Facilities with services matching ANY of the provided categories are returned

3

Detail search by category

GET

/api/v1/channels/{channelId}/client/facilitydiscovery/search/detail?serviceCategoryIds={id}

Full search with services filtered to matching categories; verify serviceCategoryIds array in response

4

Search without filter

GET

/api/v1/channels/{channelId}/client/facilitydiscovery/search

All facilities returned regardless of category

Validation:

- Services in the response include serviceCategoryIds arrays with correct decomposed values

- Filtering by a category that no service has returns zero results

- The category string field on services shows the human-readable concatenated name

Step 8 — Test Client API (Facility Discovery)

Test the 5 client-facing facility discovery endpoints and validate responses.

#

Action

Method

Endpoint

Key Validations

1

Search facilities

GET

/api/v1/channels/{channelId}/client/facilitydiscovery/search

Returns facilities matching search/geo criteria; check latitude, longitude, productVerticalType filters

2

Get facility summary

GET

/api/v1/channels/{channelId}/client/facilitydiscovery/facilities/{facilityId}/summary

Returns basic facility info (amenities, operating hours, timezone); no offerings/services

3

Get facility detail

GET

/api/v1/channels/{channelId}/client/facilitydiscovery/facilities/{facilityId}/detail

Returns full hierarchy (offerings → services); no date-specific availability

4

Get facility availability

GET

/api/v1/channels/{channelId}/client/facilitydiscovery/facilities/{facilityId}/availability?date={yyyyMMdd}

Returns services with availability calendar for the specified date; verify timeslots are present

5

Search with detail

GET

/api/v1/channels/{channelId}/client/facilitydiscovery/search/detail

Full search with services, rate sets, and timeslots; validate pricing and availability

Validation: Confirm that facilities synced in Steps 2–6 appear in search results with correct offerings, services, and availability data.

Step 9 — Test Booking & Cancellation

#

Action

Method

Endpoint

Key Validations

1

Get supported providers

GET

/api/v1/channels/{channelId}/management/booking/providers

Returns list of supported providers (USC, CCH)

2

Make a reservation

POST

/api/v1/channels/{channelId}/management/booking/reserve?provider={USC\|CCH}

Booking succeeds; confirmation number returned

3

Verify booking reflected

GET

/api/v1/channels/{channelId}/client/facilitydiscovery/facilities/{facilityId}/availability?date={yyyyMMdd}

The booked timeslot shows as unavailable / reduced capacity

4

Cancel the reservation

POST

/api/v1/channels/{channelId}/management/booking/cancel?provider={USC\|CCH}

Cancellation succeeds using confirmation number

5

Verify cancellation reflected

GET

/api/v1/channels/{channelId}/client/facilitydiscovery/facilities/{facilityId}/availability?date={yyyyMMdd}

The previously booked timeslot is available again

Validation: After booking, the availability endpoint should reflect the consumed timeslot. After cancellation, the timeslot should be restored.

---
Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] CRM → MongoDB data sync completes successfully via Hangfire jobs

- [ ] Interface configurations can be created/read/updated/deleted via the Management API

- [ ] Product verticals can be created (with auto-incremented Value), listed, updated, activated, deactivated, and deleted

- [ ] Product verticals can be assigned to offerings via the assign endpoint using Value and CRM ID

- [ ] Service categories can be created, listed, activated, deactivated, and deleted

- [ ] Service categories can be assigned to services and the bitmask/name is correctly computed

- [ ] Bootstrap job creates the expected reconciliation jobs (cm-recon-cch, cm-recon-usc)

- [ ] Reconciliation jobs create facility-specific sync jobs and successfully sync upstream provider data

- [ ] FacilityDiscovery documents contain ServiceCategoryIds after rebuild

- [ ] Search endpoints correctly filter by serviceCategoryIds query parameter

- [ ] All 5 client facility discovery endpoints return correct data including category information

- [ ] Booking endpoint successfully creates a reservation and timeslot availability is updated

- [ ] Cancellation endpoint successfully cancels a reservation and timeslot availability is restored

issues.summary: Implement Payment Processing Entity Model and Routing System
issues.description:
Overview

Design and implement a payment processing routing system backed by MongoDB Atlas. The system maps a MerchantAccount and CurrencyCode to a set of supported PaymentProcessors with failover routing support, using a pre-computed materialized view to eliminate runtime aggregation.

---
High-Level Requirements

1. Entity Model — MongoDB Collections

MerchantAccount (merchantAccounts)

- Represents a business entity that processes payments

- Fields: legalName, merchantType (enum), merchantReferenceId, legacyReferenceId, profile (embedded subdoc), soft-delete fields (isDeleted/deletedAt)

- Unique indexes on legacyReferenceId and merchantReferenceId (sparse, partial filter on non-deleted)

PaymentProcessor (paymentProcessors)

- Defines a processor, the payment method it handles, required merchant configuration schema, and per-currency settings

- Fields: name, processorKey, status, paymentMethodType, requiredParams[] (with validation patterns and target field), baseParams, baseSecrets (CSFLE encrypted), currencyProfiles[]

- Each requiredParam specifies a target field (configParams or configSecrets) for validation routing

MerchantPaymentProfile (merchantPaymentProfiles)

- Maps a merchant to a specific processor for a given payment method and currency

- Supports failover routing via priority field (0 = primary, 1 = first fallback, etc.)

- Fields: merchantId (FK), paymentMethodType, currencyCode, paymentProcessorId (FK), priority, status, configParams (plain), configSecrets (CSFLE encrypted)

- Compound unique indexes enforce one-processor-per-priority and one-priority-per-processor per merchant/method/currency

2. Materialized View — merchantProcessorRoutes

- Pre-computed join of profiles and processors, rebuilt via Atlas Database Triggers

- Groups by merchantId + paymentMethodType + currencyCode with ordered processors array

- Denormalizes merchantReferenceId and processorKey for direct lookups

- Carries both plaintext params and encrypted secrets (CSFLE passthrough)

- Primary routing query: lookup by merchantId (or merchantReferenceId) + currencyCode

3. Rebuild Pipeline (Atlas Triggers)

- Triggered on changes to merchantPaymentProfiles and paymentProcessors

- Scoped rebuild for affected merchant(s) only

- Pipeline: match non-inactive profiles → sort by priority → $lookup processors (non-inactive, active currency) → $lookup merchant accounts (non-deleted) → group → $merge upsert

- Stale route cleanup: delete route documents with empty processors array post-rebuild

- Scheduled trigger for periodic full rebuild as consistency safety net

4. Encryption — Atlas CSFLE

- All *Secrets fields encrypted via Client-Side Field Level Encryption

- Encryption/decryption in the MongoDB driver (AutoEncryptionSettings)

- KMS provider: AWS KMS / Azure Key Vault / GCP KMS (local key for dev)

- Random encryption algorithm (no equality queries needed on secrets)

- Materialized view passes encrypted BinData through; decryption at read time by driver

5. Cross-Cutting Concerns

Soft Deletes

- Entities with status field: Inactive = soft delete, partial filter indexes exclude inactive

- Entities without status (MerchantAccount): explicit isDeleted/deletedAt fields

Config Params vs Secrets Split

- configParams/baseParams: non-sensitive, plaintext, queryable, visible in Atlas UI

- configSecrets/baseSecrets: sensitive, CSFLE encrypted, opaque BinData on server

6. Transaction Routing Context (Capture-Time Snapshot)

- On payment capture, snapshot routing context onto the transaction record

- Snapshot: processorKey, processorId, profileId, configParams (plain), processorTransactionRef

- Enables post-capture operations (refunds, voids) independent of current profile state

- Do NOT snapshot secrets or currencyProfile details

7. Application-Layer Validation

- Cross-document validation of configParams/configSecrets against PaymentProcessor.requiredParams

- Validate plaintext values before encryption

- MongoDB schema validators use bsonType: "binData" for encrypted fields

---
Enums

Enum

Values

MerchantType

GolfFacility, ServiceProvider, Aggregator

PaymentMethodType

GiftCard, CreditCard, AccountBalance, ApplePay, PayPal, etc

Status

Active, Inactive, Pending

---
Reference

Full entity design spec: payment-processing-entity-design.md

issues.summary: RMS Admin UI: Expose IsWaivable and IsRefundable Toggles on Fee Configuration
issues.description:
GOAL

Add IsWaivable and IsRefundable toggle controls to the existing Fee Configuration admin interface in RMS so that operations and course admins can configure per-fee-type waiver and refund behavior.

---
Summary

The database columns and DAL plumbing for IsWaivable and IsRefundable already exist (CORE-14444 added the columns, CORE-14510 plumbed them through the DTO). This ticket surfaces them in the RMS admin UI.

The existing Fee Configuration admin pattern already handles other boolean properties via checkboxes with AJAX save. Follow that same established pattern for these two new toggles.

Both values default to true (matching database column defaults), so all existing fee configurations remain fully waivable and refundable unless an admin explicitly changes them.

Acceptance Criteria

- Two new checkboxes ("Waivable" and "Refundable") appear on the Fee Configuration add/edit form

- Values persist correctly at all hierarchy levels (Owner, Facility, Rate Set)

- Default state is checked (true) for both on new fee configurations

- Existing fee configuration CRUD operations continue to work without regression

- UI clearly communicates what each toggle controls (consider tooltip or help text)

Key Integration Points

- _AddFeeConfiguration.cshtml (Razor view, existing checkbox pattern)

- AddFeeConfiguration.js (client-side AJAX save)

- AdministrationController.cs (server-side endpoints)

- FeeConfiguration DTO/model objects (already have the properties from CORE-14510)

Dependencies

- CORE-14510 must be merged first

---
Technical Findings

See attached MD file for details on the existing admin pattern, DTO path, database defaults, and hierarchy behavior considerations.

comments.author: Joshua Marquess
comments.body:
Technical Findings: RMS Admin UI - IsWaivable / IsRefundable Toggles

Current State

The Fee Configuration admin interface in RMS already supports CRUD operations for fee configurations at Owner, Facility, and Rate Set (Course) hierarchy levels. The IsWaivable and IsRefundable columns exist in the database (CORE-14444) and are plumbed through the DAL DTO (CORE-14510) but are not yet surfaced in the admin UI.

Existing Admin UI Pattern

The fee configuration admin follows a consistent pattern:

Component

Location

Role

AdministrationController.cs

RMS Web project

Server-side CRUD endpoints for fee configuration

_AddFeeConfiguration.cshtml

RMS Views

Razor partial with form fields (checkboxes for booleans)

AddFeeConfiguration.js

RMS Scripts

Client-side AJAX for save/update operations

The existing pattern uses checkboxes for boolean properties on fee configurations. IsWaivable and IsRefundable follow this same pattern.

Database Defaults

Both columns default to true in the database (per CORE-14444):

- IsWaivable BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1

- IsRefundable BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1

The admin UI should reflect these defaults (checkboxes checked by default on new fee configurations).

DTO Path

The Framework DTO (GolfNow.Framework.Pricing.Fees.Data.DTO.FeeConfiguration) already has IsWaivable and IsRefundable boolean properties (added in CORE-14510). These flow through Dapper auto-mapping from the stored procedure Revenue.GetFeeConfigurationByOwnerFacilityCourse.

The save/update path will need corresponding stored procedure parameters added (or confirmed to already exist from CORE-14444's migration).

Hierarchy Behavior

Fee configuration follows Owner > Facility > Rate Set override hierarchy. The UI already handles this for other fields. The new toggles should follow the same inheritance/override pattern.

Considerations

- Clear labeling so admins understand what "Waivable" means (GP loyalty members won't be charged this fee) vs. "Refundable" (this fee amount is included in refund calculations on cancellation)

- Whether to show these fields only when IsFeeConfigurationEnabled is active, or always (since they are inert without the backend logic from CORE-14562 and CORE-14563)

The save/update path will need corresponding stored procedure parameters added (or confirmed to already exist from CORE-14444's migration).

Hierarchy Behavior

Fee configuration follows Owner > Facility > Rate Set override hierarchy. The UI already handles this for other fields. The new toggles should follow the same inheritance/override pattern.

Considerations

  • Clear labeling so admins understand what "Waivable" means (GP loyalty members won't be charged this fee) vs. "Refundable" (this fee amount is included in refund calculations on cancellation)

  • Whether to show these fields only when IsFeeConfigurationEnabled is active, or always (since they are inert without the backend logic from CORE-14562 and CORE-14563)

issues.summary: Refund Workflow: Honor IsRefundable Flag Per Fee Configuration
issues.description:
GOAL

Update the refund workflow so that when building a refund invoice for a cancelled or adjusted reservation, only fees marked IsRefundable = true are included in the refund amount. Non-refundable fees stay charged to the customer.

---
Summary

Today, BuildRefundInvoiceActivity includes the full transaction fee charge in refund calculations with no refundability check. The new FeeConfiguration.IsRefundable flag (CORE-14444/CORE-14510) needs to be consumed here so that non-refundable fee portions are excluded from refunds.

There are two independent BuildRefundInvoiceActivity classes (main refund workflow and scheduled-payment refund workflow) that both need this update.

Important: Do NOT confuse this with the existing NonRefundableSubtotal mechanism. That field is a completely separate concept for GreensFee/CartFee deposit distribution, driven by RevenueDetail.IsRefundable on deposit calculators. It never touches transaction fees. This ticket requires a new, independent mechanism.

Open question for developer consideration: Should refundability be evaluated based on the fee configuration at time-of-booking vs. the current configuration? In practice this likely will not matter (refundability will rarely change after setup), but worth confirming with the team before implementation.

Acceptance Criteria

- Refund invoice only includes transaction fee amounts from fee configurations where IsRefundable = true

- Non-refundable fee portions are excluded from the refund calculation

- Both BuildRefundInvoiceActivity classes updated (main Refund workflow AND ScheduledPayment variant)

- Associated sales tax for non-refundable fees is also excluded from refund

- Feature-flagged behind IsFeeConfigurationEnabled; legacy path unchanged

- Existing refund tests pass; new tests cover mixed-refundability scenarios

Key Integration Points

- Workflow/Refund/Activities/BuildRefundInvoiceActivity.cs (primary, more complex with funded coupon code logic)

- Workflow/Refund/ScheduledPayment/Activities/BuildRefundInvoiceActivity.cs (same pattern, simpler)

- IFeeConfigurationDal / RevenueHelper for retrieving fee configs with IsRefundable values

Dependencies

- CORE-14510 must be merged first

---
Technical Findings

See attached MD file for full code-trace details including the NonRefundableSubtotal disambiguation, both file locations with line references, the current TransactionFee construction code, data access paths, and sales tax considerations.

comments.author: Joshua Marquess
comments.body:
Technical Findings: Refund Workflow - Honor IsRefundable Per Fee Configuration

Current State (No Refundability Check on Transaction Fees)

The refund workflow builds a refund invoice by reconstructing invoice line items from charge detail records. For transaction fees under the FeeConfiguration flag, it constructs a FeeAllotmentDetail + GenericFeeInvoiceItemDetail with the full charge amount, with zero awareness of whether the fee configuration was marked refundable.

Primary location: Provider/Workflow/Refund/Activities/BuildRefundInvoiceActivity.cs (lines 262-323)

Secondary location: Provider/Workflow/Refund/ScheduledPayment/Activities/BuildRefundInvoiceActivity.cs (lines 188-225)

Both files have identical TransactionFee handling logic under the IsFeeConfigurationEnabled() gate.

The Two BuildRefundInvoiceActivity Classes

These are NOT a caller/callee pair. They are two independent implementations of the same pattern for different refund workflows:

File

Namespace

State Type

Extra Complexity

Workflow/Refund/Activities/

...Workflow.Refund.Activities

RefundState

FundedCouponCode logic, charge detail distributions

Workflow/Refund/ScheduledPayment/Activities/

...ScheduledPayment.Activities

ScheduledPaymentRefundState

Simpler; no funded coupon code handling

Both must be updated.

CRITICAL: NonRefundableSubtotal is UNRELATED

The existing TeeTimeInvoiceItemDetail.NonRefundableSubtotal and FeeAllotmentDetail.NonRefundable fields are a completely separate mechanism for GreensFee/CartFee deposit distribution. They are:

- Computed from DepositCalculators collections on GreensFeeInvoiceItemDetailBase

- Driven by RevenueDetail.IsRefundable (a revenue-distribution-domain boolean, NOT the new FeeConfiguration flag)

- Type-gated in TeeTimeInvoiceItemBuilder.cs to only apply to GreensFeeInvoiceItemDetailBase or CartFeeInvoiceItemDetail (never TransactionFee)

- Assigned only in GreensFeeInvoiceItemDetailBase.cs and CartFeeInvoiceItemDetail.cs

Do NOT repurpose these fields. This ticket requires introducing a NEW mechanism keyed off FeeConfiguration.IsRefundable for the TransactionFee invoice item.

Current TransactionFee Refund Construction (Under FeeConfig Flag)

FeeAllotmentDetail tfAllotment = new FeeAllotmentDetail()
{
FeeType = InvoiceTransactionItemType.TransactionFee,
TransactionType = InvoiceTransactionItemType.TransactionFee,
TaxTransactionType = InvoiceTransactionItemType.SalesTaxTransactionFee,
OriginalAmount = item.Item.Amount,
Amount = item.Item.Amount,
IsTaxIncluded = state.TaxRateMap[TransactionItemType.TransactionFee].IsTaxIncluded,
};

var tfNew = new GenericFeeInvoiceItemDetail(tfAllotment)
{
IsTaxIncluded = ...,
TaxClassificationId = ...,
EstimatedTaxRate = ...,
DiscountedAmount = item.Item.Amount,
TransactionTypeId = ...
};
tfNew.DueOnline = true;
tfNew.SetSubtotal(item.Item.Amount);

There is no IsRefundable check anywhere in this flow today.

Data Access Path

Fee configurations (with IsRefundable) are accessible via:

- IFeeConfigurationDal.GetFeeConfiguration(IEnumerable contexts) returns IEnumerable<Tuple<FeeContext, IEnumerable<FeeConfiguration>>>

- RevenueHelper wraps this DAL and is already registered in Autofac

The developer will need to determine how to correlate a charge-detail-level transaction fee amount back to its originating fee configuration(s) to check refundability.

Open Question for Developer

Point-in-time vs. current refundability: Should refundability be evaluated based on what the fee configuration looked like at booking time, or the current configuration? In practice, fee refundability will rarely change after initial setup, so this is likely academic. But worth confirming with the team before implementation.

Feature Flag

All new behavior gated behind Misc.CommonHelper.IsFeeConfigurationEnabled().

Sales Tax Handling

The refund flow also handles TransactionItemType.SalesTaxTransactionFee (lines 391-458 in the main file). If a fee is non-refundable, its associated sales tax should also be excluded from refund.
